events.title: A Cozier Village and a More Convenient Store
events.summary: Development of Russian Village Business is moving forward.We've now completed 6 product licenses, each containing 6 products that can be ordered by phone. We already have ideas for the remaining four licenses, but we'd like to make them different. Instead of adding more imported goods, we're planning to introduce locally produced products. events.title: 8 Months of Development: Here's What's Already in the Game
events.summary: Hello everyone!There probably won't be any major art updates this week, so we thought it would be a great opportunity to look back and see how much Russian Village Business has grown.Over the past eight months, the game has expanded far beyond its original concept. What started as a simple idea about running a village shop has evolved into a living world filled with locations, villagers, interactive objects, and gameplay systems.Russian Village Business is an economic shop management simulator.
